user_input: 请根据我上传的数据绘制百分比堆积柱状图，展示华北、华东、华南、西部四个地区财政支出中教育、医疗、交通、其他四项的占比结构；四个地区各为一根柱，四项自下而上堆叠至 100% 并加上图例；添加图表标题、X 轴（地区）与 Y 轴（占比/%）标签。
ai_response:
```latex
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[
    ybar stacked,
    width=11cm, height=7cm,
    bar width=22pt,
    title={2024年各地区财政支出结构占比},
    xlabel={地区},
    ylabel={占比（\%）},
    symbolic x coords={华北,华东,华南,西部},
    xtick=data,
    ymin=0, ymax=100,
    ytick={0,20,40,60,80,100},
    enlarge x limits={abs=0.6},
    legend style={at={(1.03,0.5)}, anchor=west, draw=black, fill=white},
    legend columns=1,
    ymajorgrids,
    grid style={dashed, gray!30}
]
\addplot[fill=blue!55, draw=blue!70,
         nodes near coords, point meta=explicit symbolic,
         every node near coord/.append style={anchor=center, font=\tiny, fill=none, draw=none, inner sep=1pt}]
    coordinates {(华北,32)[32\%] (华东,28)[28\%] (华南,30)[30\%] (西部,35)[35\%]};
\addplot[fill=red!50, draw=red!70,
         nodes near coords, point meta=explicit symbolic,
         every node near coord/.append style={anchor=center, font=\tiny, fill=none, draw=none, inner sep=1pt}]
    coordinates {(华北,26)[26\%] (华东,30)[30\%] (华南,25)[25\%] (西部,24)[24\%]};
\addplot[fill=green!45, draw=green!60!black,
         nodes near coords, point meta=explicit symbolic,
         every node near coord/.append style={anchor=center, font=\tiny, fill=none, draw=none, inner sep=1pt}]
    coordinates {(华北,22)[22\%] (华东,24)[24\%] (华南,28)[28\%] (西部,20)[20\%]};
\addplot[fill=orange!60, draw=orange!80!black,
         nodes near coords, point meta=explicit symbolic,
         every node near coord/.append style={anchor=center, font=\tiny, fill=none, draw=none, inner sep=1pt}]
    coordinates {(华北,20)[20\%] (华东,18)[18\%] (华南,17)[17\%] (西部,21)[21\%]};
\legend{教育,医疗,交通,其他}
\node[anchor=north west, font=\scriptsize] at (axis description cs:0.0,-0.15)
    {注：四项占比自下而上堆叠，各地区合计均为 100\%。};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
```
